title: Red Hat Security Advisory: git-lfs security update
description: Red Hat issued a security advisory for git-lfs addressing three denial of service vulnerabilities in underlying Go libraries used by git-lfs. The issues include excessive recursion in ASN.1 unmarshaling, indefinite TLS KeyUpdate messages, and excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames. These flaws could cause denial of service conditions when processing maliciously crafted inputs. Red Hat has released updated git-lfs packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 to remediate these issues.
